fusions.name: Stinger in Each Sucker
fusions.desc: Slaps an arm onto the target for 3 damage and every sucker stings it, leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sting Follows Sting
fusions.desc: Lashes every arm outward, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Dawn-to-Dusk Labour
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Alarm Scent
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, an arm darts at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.
